reference_sql:
SELECT a.campaign_id, a.spend_date, a.spend,
       FIRST_VALUE(a.spend) OVER (PARTITION BY a.campaign_id ORDER BY a.spend_date
                                  ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_day_spend
FROM ad_spend_daily a
JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
WHERE c.channel_id = 2
  AND a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'
alternatives:
WITH first_days AS (  -- one row per brand_search campaign: its first day with spend in the period
  SELECT a.campaign_id, MIN(a.spend_date) AS first_date
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE c.channel_id = 2
    AND a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'
  GROUP BY a.campaign_id
)
SELECT a.campaign_id, a.spend_date, a.spend, f.spend AS first_day_spend
FROM ad_spend_daily a
JOIN first_days fd ON fd.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
JOIN ad_spend_daily f ON f.campaign_id = fd.campaign_id AND f.spend_date = fd.first_date
WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'

SELECT a.campaign_id, a.spend_date, a.spend,
       FIRST_VALUE(a.spend) OVER (PARTITION BY a.campaign_id ORDER BY a.spend_date
                                  ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_day_spend
FROM ad_spend_daily a
JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
WHERE c.channel_id = 2
  AND a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'

other_way.sql:
WITH first_days AS (  -- one row per brand_search campaign: its first day with spend in the period
  SELECT a.campaign_id, MIN(a.spend_date) AS first_date
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE c.channel_id = 2
    AND a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'
  GROUP BY a.campaign_id
)
SELECT a.campaign_id, a.spend_date, a.spend, f.spend AS first_day_spend
FROM ad_spend_daily a
JOIN first_days fd ON fd.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
JOIN ad_spend_daily f ON f.campaign_id = fd.campaign_id AND f.spend_date = fd.first_date
WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'
other_way.tradeoff: Joining each campaign's first day back to its rows works on any engine, but FIRST_VALUE says the same in one line.

solver.query:
SELECT s.campaign_id, s.spend_date, s.spend,
       FIRST_VALUE(s.spend) OVER (PARTITION BY s.campaign_id ORDER BY s.spend_date
                                  ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS first_day_spend
FROM ad_spend_daily s
JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = s.campaign_id
WHERE c.channel_id = 2
  AND s.spend_date >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND s.spend_date <= DATE '2025-10-31'
